name: page-header-simple
issues: The linked frame "page header" is a generic wrapper around a single "page header" instance, which shares its name with the page header that has an image (imported as page-header). This one is the variant with a breadcrumb, title and description, so it is named page-header-simple.
A layer is named with variant strings ("variant=text, is current=false, is truncated=false") instead of a meaningful name.
Text layers have no meaningful names (breadcrumb, title and description are bare text nodes).
The breadcrumb text uses a hard-coded color (#6b6a68) and the "link-mono" font in the layer instead of variable bindings.
